observations.question: Is cardiomegaly present, and if so, how would you characterize its severity?
observations.observation: The provided chest radiographs demonstrate a widened mediastinum and an increased cardiac silhouette on the posteroanterior (PA) view. The cardiothoracic ratio appears to be greater than 0.5 on the PA view, which is suggestive of cardiomegaly. The lateral view also shows an enlarged cardiac shadow. However, precise measurement of the cardiac silhouette and cardiothoracic ratio is difficult due to the image quality and lack of clear landmarks. The degree of cardiomegaly is difficult to characterize precisely without further quantitative measurements and comparison to prior imaging.
